about_the_game:
Birdteeth is a casual, single-player creature collector where you get to observe, feed, and befriend birds. Train your feathered companions, reshape the world around you, and interact with hidden secrets and puzzles left over from ancient times.

In the demo, you'll be able to:

  • Forage for seeds

  • Feed the birds and earn their trust

  • Collect... teeth?

  • Train your birds

  • Explore and shape the world

_

Birdteeth is currently in a very early demo stage and will be continuously updated! If you like it, please give us a wishlist!
